context_requirements: Expression of retinoic acid receptors (RARA, RARB, RARG) or retinoid X receptors (RXRA, RXRB, RXRG)
Cellular machinery for retinoic acid synthesis/metabolism (ALDH1A1/2/3, CYP26A1) or ability to take up and retain retinoids
Intact retinoid signaling cofactors (NCOA, NCOR) and chromatin remodeling complexes
For growth inhibition, dependence on AP-1 or other retinoid-sensitive proliferation pathways
falsifiers: No consistent change in canonical retinoic acid target genes (e.g., CYP26A1, RARB, TGM2) at 6 or 24 h in any cell line
No dose-dependent or time-dependent transcriptional response across the nine cell lines
Strong upregulation of proliferation genes or absence of any antiproliferative signature at 24 h
Responses that are indistinguishable from vehicle or from unrelated drug classes
